blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A .45-caliber pistol was recovered from a Grade 10 student inside a classroom in Brgy. Dalakit in Catarman, Northern Samar, on Thursday, Oct. 1, according to the Police Regional Office 8. In a statement on Friday, police said the gun was retrieved after another student reported to a teacher that the minor was carrying a firearm inside the classroom.
